Class for representing HDF5 attributes

Source: R/R6Classes_H5A.R
H5A.Rd

This class represents an HDF5 attribute. Usually it is easier to read and write attributes for groups, datasets and committed datatypes using the functions documented in h5attributes.

Otherwise, the functionality for attributes is very similar to that of datasets (H5D), however with the notable exception that attributes always have to be read and written as a whole.

H5A$flush()

This function implements the HDF5-API function H5Fflush. Please see the documentation at https://support.hdfgroup.org/documentation/hdf5/latest/group___h5_f.html for details.

Usage

H5A$flush(scope = h5const$H5F_SCOPE_GLOBAL)

Arguments

scope

The scope of the flush; one of the H5F_SCOPE_* values in h5const.

H5A$read_low_level()

Only for advanced users. See documentation for read instead. This function implements the HDF5-API function H5Aread. Please see the documentation at https://support.hdfgroup.org/documentation/hdf5/latest/group___h5_a.html for details.

Usage

H5A$read_low_level(buffer, mem_type, duplicate_buffer = FALSE)

Arguments

buffer

The raw buffer to read into or write from.

mem_type

The memory datatype to use for the transfer; an object of class H5T.

duplicate_buffer

Logical; should the buffer be copied before it is returned.

H5A$write()

Writes the data of robj to the attribute

Usage

H5A$write(robj, mem_type = NULL, flush = getOption("hdf5r.flush_on_write"))

Arguments

robj

The object to write into the attribute

mem_type

The memory data type to use when transferring from HDF5 to intermediate storage. This is an advanced development feature and may be removed in the future.

flush

Logical; should the file be flushed after the write.

H5A$print()

Prints information for the dataset

Usage

H5A$print(...)

Arguments

...

Examples

fname <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5")
file <- H5File$new(fname, mode = "a")
h5attr(file, "attr_numeric") <- rnorm(10)
a <- file$attr_open("attr_numeric")
a$get_info()
#>   corder_valid corder cset data_size
#> 1            0      0    0        80
a$attr_name()
#> [1] "attr_numeric"
a$get_space()
#> Class: H5S
#> Type: Simple
#> Dims: 10
#> Maxdims: 10
a$get_type()
#> Class: H5T_FLOAT
#> Datatype: H5T_IEEE_F64LE
a$get_storage_size()
#> [1] 80
a$read()
#>  [1] -1.400043517  0.255317055 -2.437263611 -0.005571287  0.621552721
#>  [6]  1.148411606 -1.821817661 -0.247325302 -0.244199607 -0.282705449
a$write(10:1)
a$print()
#> Class: H5A
#> Attribute: attr_numeric
#> Datatype: H5T_IEEE_F64LE
#> Space: Type=Simple     Dims=10     Maxdims=10
a$close()
file$close_all()
